metadata.scenario: A prospect urgently needs a locksmith service as they are locked out of their house, with no alternative entry. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I assist you today? Hi, my name is Jennifer Taylor. I urgently need help. I'm locked out of my house! Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that, Jennifer. That sounds stressful. Yes, it really is! I have no way to get inside, and my grandmother is waiting for her caregiver. I understand. Unfortunately, we don't provide locksmith services. Oh, I see. Do you have any recommendations? I can refer you to a local locksmith service if that helps. Yes, please! That would be great. Let me gather that information for you. Are you near the Wichita area? Yes, I'm in Wichita! Perfect. I’ll look up some locksmiths nearby. Could you hold for just a moment? Sure, thank you. [pause] Okay, I found a locksmith called “Quick Lock Solutions.” Their number is +13165551234. They’re known for urgent calls. Thank you! I’ll call them right away. You're welcome! Just to confirm, is there anything else you need help with while I have you on the line? Yes, actually. I was looking for companion care for my elderly grandmother. We can definitely help with that. We offer companion care starting at $25 per hour. That sounds reasonable. What does it include? It includes social interaction, help with daily activities, and light housekeeping. That sounds perfect! Would you like to schedule a consultation for your grandmother? Yes, I think that would be great. I can have our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, give you a call to discuss care plans. That would help a lot. Just to confirm, can I get your best contact number again? Yes, it’s +13165554817. Great! I will have Lisa reach out to you today. Thank you so much for your help! You're very welcome, Jennifer. I hope the locksmith arrives quickly! Thank you! Have a great day! You too! Goodbye!
